# @lynxland/uikit

> Data-dense console UI library: three **data capabilities** (Query / Command / Stream)
> composed through explicit bindings and presentation layers, on TanStack engines.
> Built agent-first, for agents guided by humans.

- **Current architecture (v3 `3.0.0` cutover)**: [docs/design.md](docs/design.md) — two axes, seven layers, target APIs, migration plan.
- **Concept audit (why v2 was confusing)**: [docs/audits/2026-11-07-conceptual-audit.md](docs/audits/2026-11-07-conceptual-audit.md)
- **Current v3 API guide**: [docs/SKILL.md](docs/SKILL.md)
- **Supported versions**: [docs/versions.md](docs/versions.md)
- **Archived draft-2 design + decision log**: [docs/design-history.md](docs/design-history.md)
- **Repo guide**: [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md)

## Map

- `@lynxland/uikit-core` — headless contracts + schema + adapters (**no React**):
  CollectionSource/RecordSource/LookupSource, CollectionState/Request/Page, Command/Outcome,
  StreamSource/FrameSource, ApiError, Entity.
- `@lynxland/uikit-react` — data/command/stream bindings + queryOptions; `/router` for URL/search
  (`useCollectionPage`, `useSearchState`).
- `@lynxland/uikit-surfaces` — UI-library-agnostic values/controls/views/chrome/fields +
  `UiAdapter` contract.
- `@lynxland/uikit-ui-shadcn` — default UI adapter: Base UI + shadcn primitives/tokens.
- `@lynxland/uikit-ui-plain` — optional minimal adapter: plain HTML/CSS, no Tailwind/Base UI.
- `@lynxland/uikit-preset-console` — opinionated, runnable pages/views/chrome/fields/CRUD.
- `@lynxland/uikit-testing` / `@lynxland/uikit-cli` — test harness / init·eject·doctor·scaffold.
- `@lynxland/uikit` — one-install meta entry; re-exports the preset.
- `@lynxland/uikit-cli` — `init` / `eject surfaces|preset-console` / `doctor` (copy-owned code).
- `apps/demo` — living docs: every Page Template is a runnable page

## Concepts (two axes)

**Data capabilities**: Query (cached reads), Command (named writes with structured outcomes),
Stream (cursor-positioned frames). **Entity** is an optional named grouping for keys/scope/invalidation;
`Resource` is **deleted** in v3; Entity is not a fourth primitive.

**Presentation layers**: Value → Control → View → Chrome → Page Composition. Controls are controlled props
(no data fetching, no Router); Views bind handles; Chrome owns the page shell; preset pages are thin compositions;
Page Templates / scaffold are not stable component APIs.

**Preset** is the out-of-the-box layer: default pages/views/chrome/fields/CRUD. **UI Adapter** is the UI
adaptation seam: visual primitives + tokens. Core stays headless; preset is opinionated but ejectable;
UI adapter is replaceable.

Everything else derives from these two axes; see design.md §1–§6.

## Status

Current package: `3.0.0` (v3). The cutover has **no backward compatibility** (design.md §8):
v2 APIs were deleted, not aliased; v2 history is in design-history.md.
Batch 1–4 are implemented (core/react/testing/surfaces/ui-shadcn/ui-plain/preset/meta/demo/CLI);
remaining: clean-room install smoke and external fleetly/torchwood migration.
